description: Creates a TEXT layer with the words you give it. The font is loaded before anything is typed, and a font this machine does not have is refused rather than substituted. Give a width to make it wrap; without one it hugs its text.

fontStyle.description: Weight or style, like "Bold". Default Regular.

name.description: Layer name. Defaults to the text itself.

parentId.description: Put it inside this node. Default: the current page.

width.description: Fixed width, so the text wraps.

name: figma_create_text
title: Add a text layer
